plugins.name: crux-growth-skills
plugins.description: Crux best practice for working with your own data in your own Claude. Ships alongside your Crux Growth Brain and adds the craft the brain does not carry. It carries a Black Friday plan: last year's Black Friday read on your own data, your November and December targets tested against it, and an agreed plan with day-by-day targets you can download.
